rationale: The plan uses DESeq2 Wald test (with edgeR QL and limma-voom concordance checks) on raw counts for an unpaired 3v3 single-batch design, explicitly avoiding alpha manipulation and stating low power quantitatively via a dedicated power/leave-one-out/concordance step. QC (PCA, sample-sample distance, library size, correlation-based outlier flagging) precedes testing with a clear no-drop policy. Filtering is minimal and stated (count>=10 in >=3 samples); normalization is fully internal via DESeq2 size factors with no pre-normalized inputs. Design formula ~condition with control as reference is explicit, though no blocking/interaction term is needed or discussed since none exists in this simple design. BH FDR at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage used for ranking/plotting is correctly specified, and thresholds are built into the test rather than applied post hoc. GSEA uses the full ranking with stated ranking metric (Wald statistic), named collections (Hallmark, GO-BP) with size bounds and match-rate reporting, appropriately treated as hypothesis-generating. The report step specifies versions are to be stated, exact counts, thresholds, and caveats about design limitations, fulfilling completeness requirements.
